theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenVar_exists_isOpen_superset_measure_sdiff_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (O K : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → (∀ L : Set (Rn N), IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → μ L < ∞) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ V : Set (Rn N), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ O ∧ μ V < ∞ ∧ μ (V \ K) < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
